name: @intellectual-frontiers/ergonex
description: Ergonex, the workspaces management of Intellectual Frontiers: one command that sets up, configures and operates a team's software repositories, package registries and builds, on Windows, macOS and Linux, with Bun by default and Node 26 as the backup.

scripts.verify: tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun ../tools/mizan-check.ts --root spec-kit && bun ../ts/mizan/check.ts --root spec-kit --level L1 && bun tools/check.ts && bun tools/generate-installers.ts --check && bun test suite/
